decisions.why: Examples are disposable bipolar and monopolar forceps, monopolar electrodes, and cautery pens — all electrosurgery consumables for theatre use
Examples include xenon light sources (300W, 400W) and surgical headlight cables — capital theatre lighting and illumination equipment
Examples are extraction sets for implants and screws (hip stems, spinal screws, nails) — orthopaedic trauma fixation removal tools
Examples include Kirschner wires, arthrodesis wires, drill bits — orthopaedic trauma fixation materials
Examples are bone cement mixer syringe, mixer bowl, and pulse lavage accessories — bone cement preparation equipment for orthopaedic surgery
Examples are nitrile powder-free gloves and disposable face masks (Type IIR) — general PPE
